create_nethack_environment: create a nethack.Nethack environment with observation_keys like chars, glyphs, blstats, and program_state
run_nethack_episodes: run multiple NetHack episodes by calling game.reset then game.step with random action codes in a loop
set_nethack_seeds: set reproducible game seeds using game.set_initial_seeds(core=42, disp=666) before calling game.reset
query_nethack_monster_data: query monster and object data using nethack.permonst, nethack.objclass, nethack.class_sym, and nethack.glyph_to_mon
render_tty_output: render terminal output with ANSI colors using nethack.tty_render passing chars, colors, and cursor arrays
